purpose: Teach: 半月/高麗/理学部/無害/音痴/科学技術庁/初等/開発途上国

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、半月前の事件を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So the police are handling the incident from two weeks ago, then.
lines.style: Steady, thoughtful cadence. Soft questioning lilt at the end—not doubt, but genuine curiosity. The tone of someone working through a case methodically, making sure he understands each piece.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、高麗関連の文化財盗難も担当します
lines.en: The police also investigate cultural artifact theft related to Goryeo.
lines.style: Clear, matter-of-fact delivery. Professional confidence without coldness. Each statement lands like a checkpoint. Precise, efficient pacing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、理学部の薬品流出事件を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So the police would be handling the chemical leak incident from the science department as well.
lines.style: Slightly deeper breath before speaking. Same methodical tone as before, but now with a thread of connecting pieces—seeing a pattern emerge. Measured, careful.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、無害と称した薬物詐欺もご捜査ですね
lines.en: The police are also investigating the fraud cases involving fake 'harmless' drugs, I take it.
lines.style: Agreeable, collaborative tone. A slight nod in the voice—confirming Ren's understanding. Warm but still official. No rush in the pacing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、音痴詐欺、つまり振り込め詐欺の音声分析を、警察、進められますね
lines.en: And voice analysis for phone scams—those voice-based fraud cases—the police are pursuing those as well.
lines.style: Slower here. The weight of connecting disparate cases settling in. Quiet concentration. A pause before 'pursuing,' like he's assembling the picture piece by piece.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、旧科学技術庁時代の不正にも対応されますね
lines.en: The police also address past misconduct from the old Science and Technology Agency era.
lines.style: Steady, factual. A slight heaviness to this one—historical wrongdoing—but delivered without drama. Professional accountability in the tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、初等学校での事案を、警察、慎重に扱われますね
lines.en: So the police would handle the incident at the elementary school with appropriate care, then.
lines.style: Noticeably quieter. The word 'school' carries weight. Ren's voice softens—this one matters differently. Still methodical, but gentle-edged.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、開発途上国からの不正輸入にも対応されますね
lines.en: The police also respond to illegal imports from developing nations.
lines.style: Steady return to the official register. The close of a list. Efficient, complete. A touch warmer than purely procedural—acknowledging the full scope of responsibility.
